Subject: Hosted API trial — quick demo request

Hi Rachel,

I signed up for the Hosted API sandbox earlier today (BrightCart trial). I'm the PM on our search/recommendations team and would love a 30-minute walkthrough of the Hosted API and sandbox so we can validate latency and embeddings quality for a product experiment.

A few quick context items:
- We're a small ML team (2 engs + 1 PM).
- Main use case: re-ranking + embeddings for product discovery.
- Compliance: need an overview of retention & audit logging (high level is fine up front).

Timezone: I'm in Madrid (CEST). Best windows for us next week are Tue/Wed mornings CEST (09:00–11:30) or Thu afternoon CEST (14:00–17:00).

Can you propose a 30-minute slot and confirm whether we get ephemeral API keys for the sandbox?

Thanks —
Anna Lopez
Product Manager, BrightCart
anna@brightcart.com

Hi Anna — welcome and thanks for signing up!

We can absolutely run a 30-minute walkthrough focused on embeddings and re-ranking. I pasted a few slots below in CEST and also included a Calendly link if you prefer to pick directly: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/30min-demo

Proposed slots (CEST):
- Tue 2026-11-10 09:30–10:00
- Wed 2026-11-11 10:00–10:30
- Thu 2026-11-12 15:00–15:30

Quick answers: yes, sandbox accounts get ephemeral API keys tied to your trial org; Sean will confirm retention/audit details in a follow-up. I've attached a short pre-demo checklist to help us focus the session. If none of these work, reply with 2 windows that do.

Attachments: pre-demo-checklist.pdf (1 page)

Best,
Rachel Kim
